blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate impeachment court unveiled on Tuesday the schedule of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial in November, as it resumed proceedings followinga pause.. READ: Gatchalian: Defense to start presentation on Nov. 9 Presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero enumerated the following dates allotted for Duterte’s trial coinciding with the 20th Congress’ resumption of its second regular session: November 9: Trial at 10 a.m., to suspend for plenary at 3 p.m., resume after plenary November 10: Trial from 10 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. November 11: Trial at 10 a.m., Senate may suspend for plenary at 3 p.m. if needed […]...
